reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "feat: drop v1alpha1 EnvironmentConfigs by @phisco in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6556", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: Existing EnvironmentConfig resources using the v1alpha1 API version will be rejected and cannot be used in Crossplane 2.0.0.

proposed.statement: The v1alpha1 EnvironmentConfigs API version is no longer served in Crossplane 2.0.0.
